previousSnapshotEvidence.scope: Documentation and isolated specimens only; no full-app QA, user creative acceptance, rights grant, or production auth claim.
previousSnapshotEvidence.iconPolicy: Two never-mixed sources. Branded: unmodified upstream logo files in public/tool-icons/ with commit, URL and sha256 pinned in .qa/tool-icons-provenance.json; full-color files keep their original colors, legitimately monochrome files (OpenCode, Three.js) are inverted per theme, mask geometry (FFmpeg, GSAP) is filled with the project color in CSS. Functional: hand-drawn colored symbols only for names without a sourced logo (Canvas 2D, Editable SVG, voice synthesis, captions, Remotion after an upstream 404, HyperFrames, local study); the unknown fallback is generic and not official. Marks are decorative beside visible names and assert no endorsement, trademark rights, compatibility, or installation.
previousSnapshotEvidence.downloadPolicy: Catalog CardDownloadAction (CSS module) is always disabled with visible unavailable text and links to the real detail #download anchor; detail-page DownloadAction is the existing status-check region. No auth, eligibility, or file delivery is implemented or implied.
previousSnapshotEvidence.tonalRampPolicy: No source ramp exists. No synthesized ramp or duplicated color primitives added to silence detector advice.
previousSnapshotEvidence.snippetPolicy: Scoped ds- HTML/CSS translations of source families (globals.css plus the CardDownloadAction CSS module mapped to ds-card-download-*). Inline SVG only: exact ToolMark symbol geometry and exact pinned local logo geometry with root style/size/title removed; no , mask URL, external request or dependency. Component-scoped border-box, inherited semantic properties; document-root theme selectors are omitted. No React/Tailwind/global stylesheet. Static state examples except native search editing, focus/hover and details disclosure. Card is the truthful Thai Voice no-media branch.
knownLimitations: Primary and feature-link hover pair --purple with --action-hover-ink; the recorded computed-style check measured about 7.05:1 dark and 7.17:1 light for that action pair only (recorded before the latest review CSS fixes, which did not change those colors). This is not whole-app contrast certification.
Isolated specimens do not establish application behavior, real-media playback, intrinsic media sizing, theme persistence, download availability, or full accessibility.

narrative.overview: Thai-first purple dark/light library; real full-cover media leads. Local preview only, not a membership/download service.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width real-work hero; no preselected or auto-open solitary player.
Full-cover portrait cards with compact bottom title/action.
One honest disabled neutral primitive, context-adapted on light detail pages.
Original-color sourced marks; native playback preserves full framing.
rules: Preserve source media, paths and attribution; local derivatives are documented.
Await real decoding and natural dimensions before capture.
Source-only CI and local media/browser gates are separate.
Seven unchanged primitive specimens below remain; obsolete availability/card/download specimens are archived.
New hero/media/download families are source/token documented, not falsely represented by historical HTML exports.
dos: Inspect real desktop/tablet/mobile pixels in both themes.
Keep honest unavailable, no-media, focus and reduced-motion states.
donts: No purple matte thumbnails, giant facts body or purple dashed panels.
No copied competitor media, prices or counts.
